Thanatos, despite the vast swathes of treasures contained in the nothingness that is his realm, is god not a god fond of stagnation. By the tip of his scythe, he carves from his hoard a figure in his image. The negation of that which is already nothing leaves a void of a familiar shape. Dismayed by his failure to instigate change, Thanatos searches reality, finally leaving the way cut by his scythe open as he stares out at an odd red orb. Sensing its power, Thanatos takes his limp creation and hurls it through the way at the orb to sear his failure from existence. In a flash of power, as it leaves his realm the outline of darkness is illuminated, its empty center surrounded by a glow. Aghast, Thanatos drops the now glowing outline of his once invisible scythe and watches the glow slowly be absorbed by the void that looks back with his eyes. Its eyes radiate a muted red, too pale to be scarlet and too dark to be pink. Thanatos widens the way to come through when the creature sees past him to that which is his realm. It eyes widen and shine with the pure white light that is life. It reaches out to Thanatos and as the glow that is its hand hits the way, the light is held burning by the way with its void core limp before Thanatos. Its cries in fear but the lost that is Thanatos realm refuses to relinquish its hand. Alarmed, Thanatos reaches out to the hand but his fingers pass cleanly through it. A sad look comes into his eyes.

"I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do."

The creature hangs its head low, revealing a cool blue ring glowing from its skull.

"Will I forever be cursed to seek your glory?" It whimpers.

"I am as ignorant as you in this", he replies. "But I know as my hoard has grown with time, so shall the number of changes in this world I miss."

It stares back at him, the glow swirling in its eyes.

"Is this world what you want, oh light of mine?" Thanatos asks softly. The blue ring on its head begins to outshine the rest of its muted red glow. Its eyes become a bright yellow, and its white pupils fully illuminate Thanatos as they gleam for the first time.

"I am certain," it retorts. "May I ask one favor?"

"Name it." Thanatos smiles.

"Must I be alone?" it inquires. Thanatos stands mute for a second, before turning and removing a prize from behind him. With a groan, he forces it through the way, and it floats besides the creature.

"My gift. Call it your birthright."

"Thank you father." It intones.

"I must reclaim that which is mine. Are you ready?", the god's eyebrows furrow. "I will be free", the Light mutters resolutely.

Thanatos picks up his now shining scythe. With a scream to rend the heavens asunder, the burning blade sizzles with black goo as the hand of smoke slowly dissolves on the floor. Light dripping from its arm, the creature turns to the gift and plunges the wound into it. With a thunderous crack, the gift quickly turns from fluid into a mirror of the first creature. Astounded, the new being holds up its muted red hand and takes the now pure white fist of the First Light. Thanatos looks on in sadness as they shriek with delight into the new great unknown.

Thus was the Light born, forever destined to find those ideas once lost and convert them that they too might scour the cosmos in search of that which did not come to be,
